summary.text: Krista Anderson is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A retired Pennsylvania state employee and veteran, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she served more than 28 years in the U.S. Army and the Pennsylvania Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Krista Anderson graduated from Oxford Area High School, and Ballotpedia lists her U.S. Army service as 1984 to 2013.
She said she rose to the rank of Command Sergeant Major, was deployed twice, and spent 36 years in the criminal justice field, including more than 28 with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
Anderson said she has been a member of the Hershey Lions Club since 2002 and is serving as a Lions Clubs district governor.
She said she is a life member of the VFW, secretary of the board of the 28th Infantry Division Association, and a Penn State certified master gardener.
Anderson named integrity, community and equality as her key messages, and said she supports gift bans and term limits.
